method: Visual inspection of saved browser screenshots
observations: English desktop focus displays nested reporting controls and readable position cards.
Arabic mobile preserves RTL order, wraps long synthetic identifiers, and keeps actions within the viewport.
The mobile full-page capture retains its fixed navigation bar at the captured scroll position; no horizontal overflow was observed in browser geometry checks.
limits: Synthetic labels and company data; not HR terminology or design acceptance.
No claim of WCAG certification; ordinary keyboard expansion is covered by the browser run.
